name: North West Victoria
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A zone in northwest Victoria along the Murray River. Its two regions, Murray Darling and Swan Hill, both cross the river into New South Wales.
